source.stem:
The diagram shows the structure of a compound.

Displayed structure: C=CCCO.

Which functional groups does this molecule contain?

options.text: carboxylic acid: no; alkene: no; alcohol: no
carboxylic acid: no; alkene: yes; alcohol: yes
carboxylic acid: yes; alkene: no; alcohol: yes
carboxylic acid: yes; alkene: yes; alcohol: yes

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: The two identical tumblers contain equal volumes of water.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The narrow vessel contains more water because its water level is higher.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The tumbler with the lower water level contains the larger volume of water.

intelligence.enrichment: The space occupied by water represents its volume. Two containers can have the same capacity while holding different volumes if the amounts of water in them are different. amount of substance and space occupied -> observed volume and level in the container The learner correctly applies this rule: The space occupied by water represents its volume. Two containers can have the same capacity while holding different volumes if the amounts of water in them are different. Volume is the container capacity, so equal tumblers always contain equal volume of water.
